name: City of Raleigh
source_citation: City of Raleigh Strategic Plan Overview Report FY26-29
mission: Provides city services for North Carolina's capital city, including transit, housing, parks and utilities.
funder_affinities: Department of Housing and Urban Development

goals.title: Community safety
goals.citation: City of Raleigh Strategic Plan Overview Report FY26-29, p. 4
goals.description: Community safety: Advance a holistic approach to community safety to foster security, trust, and a sense of connection among residents.
objectives: 1. Advance a holistic approach to community safety to foster security, trust, and a sense of connection among residents

goals.title: Economic development and innovation
goals.citation: City of Raleigh Strategic Plan Overview Report FY26-29, p. 6
goals.description: Economic development and innovation: Streamline and modernize business support processes for entrepreneurs and small businesses Enhance Raleigh's local arts and culture ecosystem to drive engagement and economic growth.
objectives: 1. Streamline and modernize business support processes for entrepreneurs and small businesses
2. Enhance Raleigh's local arts and culture ecosystem to drive engagement and economic growth

goals.title: Environmental resilience
goals.citation: City of Raleigh Strategic Plan Overview Report FY26-29, p. 9
goals.description: Environmental resilience: Expand community and climate resilience programs, with a focus on protecting communities at highest risk from environmental hazards (extreme heat, flooding).
objectives: Expand community and climate resilience programs, with a focus on protecting communities at highest risk from environmental hazards (extreme heat, flooding)

goals.title: Housing
goals.citation: City of Raleigh Strategic Plan Overview Report FY26-29, p. 11
goals.description: Housing: Advance proven solutions to mitigate housing insecurity Promote walkable, mixed-income communities that expand housing choices and integrate with transit.
objectives: 1. Advance proven solutions to mitigate housing insecurity
2. Promote walkable, mixed-income communities that expand housing choices and integrate with transit

goals.title: Organizational excellence
goals.citation: City of Raleigh Strategic Plan Overview Report FY26-29, p. 13
goals.description: Organizational excellence: Seamless service experience so all residents can easily access city services Consistent and responsive city services Strengthen workforce capacity.
objectives: 1. Seamless service experience so all residents can easily access city services

goals.title: Quality of life
goals.citation: City of Raleigh Strategic Plan Overview Report FY26-29, p. 16
goals.description: Quality of life: Ensure and expand access to Raleigh's arts, parks, cultural, and recreational assets.
objectives: 1. Ensure and expand access to Raleigh's arts, parks, cultural, and recreational assets

goals.title: Transportation and transit
goals.citation: City of Raleigh Strategic Plan Overview Report FY26-29, p. 18
goals.description: Transportation and transit: Enhance mobility and accessibility by improving transit frequency, pedestrian safety, and connections between transportation options.
objectives: 1. Enhance mobility and accessibility by improving transit frequency, pedestrian safety, and connections between transportation options
